items.text: Today’s @WaysMeansCmte hearing was an opportunity to learn about how we can create equitable access to mental health services and build integrated care systems to better serve those who need this crucial treatment.

On National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, we recognize the tools we have such as testing, education, and treatment and remember the importance of building on these efforts, especially in communities of color. We can #StopHIVTogether. #NBHAAD https://t.co/ljyyx6p2TG

César Chávez fought for the dignity of a living wage, fair treatment, & safe working conditions. His work and message are so relevant today, which is why we must keep working to expand access to family-supporting wages, childcare, & paid family and medical leave. #CésarChávezDay
Today, I was experiencing very mild symptoms associated with COVID-19. I got tested as a precaution and tested positive for COVID-19. I’m following guidance from my doctors and quarantining.
Thread: Regarding my positive COVID-19 test and public schedule, I started noticing I had mild symptoms associated with COVID-19 last night. (1/4)

I’m grateful to have great health care, which I believe every person should have. 

I’m quarantining right now & so appreciative that my symptoms are mild. The thing about being in isolation is that it will force me to clean my bedroom! I can’t look away from it any longer! (4/4)

Every American deserves safe working conditions and fair treatment on the job. On #WorkersMemorialDay, let us remember the workers who lost their lives and remain fiercely dedicated to protecting workers now and in the future. (1/2)

Had a wonderful tour at the Versiti Blood Research Institute, where I saw cutting-edge research projects tackling health disparities, including improving treatment for those with sickle cell disease. I am so proud of the life-saving work happening here in Wisconsin’s Fourth. https://t.co/HPlAUDuYbV

I voted for the Community Services Block Grant Modernization Act of 2022, which helps provides life-changing housing, nutrition, career, and education assistance for those struggling with poverty. This bill also includes my amendment to reduce food insecurity. (2/3)

This omnibus package includes funding to support all 10 of my community projects for our district. These projects will help fund a new community wellness center, support needed home renovations for seniors & low-income homeowners, & help construct a park & a library, and more.

Today, #CongressGoesPurple to recognize #RecoveryMonth. If you are facing substance use or mental health challenges, treatment is available and recovery is possible.

If you need help, find resources at: https://t.co/1qMjksNjhi https://t.co/DGvwM9m4yi

As we move into winter, COVID cases are expected to rise. And while I urge everyone to get boosted, if you do get sick & are at-risk for serious illness & over 18, we have a free, safe, & effective treatment that you can get w/o an in-person appointment.

The #Momnibus MUST be passed to address the unconscionable racial disparities in maternal & infant health outcomes.
 
This legislative package would make critical investments in factors that influence maternal health outcomes, such as housing, transportation, & nutrition.

This new data shows the widespread effects of racism on mothers and babies, regardless of income.

These staggering figures demonstrate the dire need for investments in combatting the maternal mortality crisis & equitable treatment of mothers and children.
https://t.co/kHVXimpLso

Lawmakers across the country have proposed a number of bills targeting LGBTQ Americans.

When LGBTQ people are demonized by their own lawmakers, it sends a message that they are not worthy of equal treatment.

Today, and every day, I stand with the LGBTQ community. https://t.co/ksueN56SiR

Did you know that March is National Nutrition Month?

Access to nutritious food is a human right, and I will always fight to protect & expand for programs that ensure all Americans can put healthy food on the table. https://t.co/Y57SP9W8dW

I support the #GlobalHERAct because reproductive care is health care. I support it because funds for essential HIV/AIDS care, primary care, nutrition, and prenatal care shouldn't come with a side of political intimidation. Time to end the #GlobalGagRule's threat to global health.

Federal investments in nutrition assistance programs, child care and education are vital for middle class and working families here in Wisconsin.

While Republicans push for devastating cuts, Democrats are fighting to lower costs, create jobs, and put people over politics. https://t.co/dubwbhCPW9

Maternal Mortality Crisis = Public Health Crisis

That's why my colleagues & I in the @BMHCaucus are fighting for the #Momnibus, a package of bills that would improve health outcomes for mothers & babies across states & all demographics.
